basics.name: Aksel Dindisyan
basics.label: Computer Science & Industrial Engineering
basics.summary: Double major in Computer Science and Industrial Engineering at Sabancı University with a 3.96 CGPA, specializing in computer vision, machine learning, and high-performance computing. Highly passionate about Computer Vision, having applied it in both academic research such as my published paper on brand logo detection at SIU and industrial implementations at Ford Otosan. Expanded expertise into Natural Language Processing (NLP) and transformer models through the CLARITY project and engineering internship at Orbislabs.

work.name: Virallab (Sabancı University)
work.summary: Created ground truth annotations by using WBF (Weighted Boxes Fusion) to aggregate multiple user annotations. Developed a computer vision pipeline by combining a DINOV3 backbone with a DETR classification head to detect brand logos on social media platforms. Proved robustness of social media based dataset by comparing models trained on VRL-SM-Logo against models trained on FlickrLogos-27.

work.name: Sabancı University
work.summary: Assisted 110 students with assignments related to operating system principles by organizing office hours. Worked on Selfie in order to explore its possible use cases in the OS curriculum.

work.name: Sabancı University
work.position: Learning Assistant IF 100 Computational Approaches to Problem Solving
work.summary: Organized weekly office hours to support a total course cohort of 670 students with lecture-related queries. Led two weekly recitation sections, guiding 63 students through Python-based problem sets and code debugging.

work.name: Mercedes-Benz Türk
work.summary: Analyzed relationships between the Strait of Hormuz Crisis and commodity prices. Developed forecasting methods that predict commodity prices in order to optimize procurement strategies. Ran Monte Carlo simulations based on extracted conflict Markov Chain probabilities in order to notify the procurement team about possible price trends.

work.name: Orbislabs AI
work.summary: Researched LLM architectures and AI agent development frameworks such as LangChain and Langflow. Engineered a CV analyzer agent in order to accelerate the hiring process. Engineered a Text2SQL converter in order to automate data processing tasks in enterprises.

work.name: Ford Otosan
work.summary: Implemented and optimized computer vision algorithms such as BEVFusion to enhance autonomous vehicle perception systems.

education.area: Computer Science and Engineering / Industrial Engineering

projects.name: Explainable HPC Optimization for Container Terminals
projects.summary: Optimized berth allocation for cargo ships using heuristics, mixed integer programming, and dynamic programming. Used OpenMP to parallelize heuristics for 40 times faster results. Trained machine learning models to predict the dwell time of containers at the terminal.

projects.name: CLARITY - Unmasking Political Question Evasions
projects.summary: Conducted extensive data analysis and feature engineering on text datasets to identify linguistic patterns of evasion. Fine-tuned transformer models (Neural Networks, ROBERTa, Llama 8B/70B), achieving a 0.74 Macro F1 score to successfully classify evasive political rhetoric within a highly imbalanced dataset.

projects.name: Machine Learning Project on Instagram Data
projects.summary: Processed large-scale Instagram datasets using Pandas, uncovering engagement trends that correlated with posting times. Developed machine learning algorithms such as random forest and gradient boosting by using Scikit-learn. Ranked 13/138 in classification task with 0.879 weighted f1 score and 7/138 in regression task with 597 regression error.

projects.name: Data Science Project on My Step Counts
projects.summary: Explored my own step count data using line graphs, histograms, box plots, and a Pearson correlation matrix. Verified hypotheses on step count trends using t-tests and Chi-square tests. Trained two distinct random forest models to predict step counts: one utilizing temporal features (time periods), and another utilizing health metrics (sleep time, weight, and well-being).
